annotations.text:
A note on colors: I couldn't reach knotnannies.com or the Instagram from this session (network was blocked), so the sage palette and fonts are a best-guess wedding aesthetic rather than lifted from your site.

- The Brand color chip above each card swaps the whole palette in one click
- Click any text to edit it - add your phone or email in the bottom band
- Two alternate style directions are sketched in the row below

When it looks right: Export PNG from the toolbar on the card you want to post.
